summary: GameVault is a self-hosted application designed for managing and playing DRM-free digital titles. It provides a central interface to organise your game library, fetch metadata, and download files directly from your own server infrastructure.
goodFor: Users with an existing collection of DRM-free games who want a centralised, web-accessible library manager akin to a personal storefront.
watchOut: The CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 licence restricts commercial use and enforces share-alike terms on adaptations, and the moderate project activity means you should verify its long-term maintenance status.
deployNotes: Containerised deployments typically require persistent volume mounts for storing game files and application data, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
